settings.title: PURPOSE
settings.subtitle: Care for Every Stage
settings.content: To help women feel comfortable, confident and like themselves through perimenopause, menopause and beyond — with gentle, science-led probiotic care.

settings.title: MISSION
settings.subtitle: Honest, Gentle Science
settings.content: To create focused probiotic formulas for the gut, mood, sleep and intimate health that address real concerns with clinically studied strains, thoughtful formulation and clear, evidence-conscious communication — without exaggerated promises or taboo.

settings.title: VISION
settings.subtitle: Menopause, Normalised
settings.content: To build Luma Pause into a trusted women’s wellness brand that makes menopause care easy to talk about, easy to understand and easy to make part of every day.

settings.heading: Made for the pause. Made for you.
settings.lead_text: At Luma Pause, we believe menopause deserves real care — built on credible science, gentle formulas and honest conversation.
settings.principle_quote: Every strain should have a reason, every ingredient should have a role, and every woman should feel heard.

settings.heading: Three co-founders. One shared standard.
settings.text:
Luma Pause was created with a simple belief: women going through perimenopause and menopause deserve care that is designed for them — not an afterthought.

Hormonal change affects far more than hot flushes. It shows up in digestion, sleep, mood, energy and intimate comfort. And research increasingly shows that the microbiome — the community of bacteria in the gut and body — plays a central role in all of these.

So we began with probiotics. Our first ritual is built around three focused steps: Balance the gut, Support the body through the pause, and Restore intimate flora.

Each Luma Pause formula uses clinically studied strains, a clear role and plain-English science. We believe care should be gentle without being vague, premium without being excessive, and effective without miracle language.

Probiotic care. Made for the pause.

settings.heading: The science of your microbiome.
settings.text:
Your gut, vaginal and urinary flora change as oestrogen levels fall. We select strains that have been studied in women, at meaningful doses, and pair them with prebiotics and botanicals that support them.

Every formula is shaped through structured research, careful strain selection, and stability testing — so the count on the label is what reaches you.

settings.title: Listen first
settings.description: We start by listening to women about what perimenopause and menopause actually feel like, before a single strain is chosen.

settings.title: Define the challenge
settings.description: Insights are shaped into a structured brief with clear, measurable performance goals.

settings.title: Engineer with intent
settings.description: Clinically studied strains are selected and combined based on the evidence for how they support women’s health.

settings.title: Test for performance
settings.description: Each formula runs through stability, potency and safety testing before it goes anywhere near a customer.

settings.title: Validate at scale
settings.description: Formulas are refined through real-world use by women at different stages of the transition.

settings.title: Deliver with precision
settings.description: Capsules are produced in GMP-certified facilities, with the same quality and potency checks on every batch.

settings.heading: Insight-led. Intentionally built.
settings.text: Every formula follows the same disciplined path from question to shelf.

settings.heading: Precision at every step.
settings.text:
Our manufacturing process is built around control, consistency and quality. From sourcing and formulation to production and packaging, every stage follows strict checks to ensure safety, stability and performance.

Each batch is held to the same standard, so you get the same quality every time.

settings.heading: The ones who stand behind Luma Pause.
settings.text: A small, multidisciplinary team spanning research, formulation, design and operations — all working toward the same standard.

settings.title: It Started With a Question
settings.description: Why is menopause care still so hard to talk about, so confusing to shop for, and so rarely designed around how women actually feel?

settings.title: We Chose to Build Differently
settings.description: Luma Pause was created around a simple idea: combine credible microbiome science, gentle formulation and calm, beautiful design — without fear-based claims.

settings.title: We Looked at the Whole Picture
settings.description: Bloating. Hot flushes. Poor sleep. Mood changes. Intimate discomfort. We looked at how these connect through the microbiome, rather than treating each in isolation.

settings.title: The System Took Shape
settings.description: From that thinking came our first probiotic ritual: BALANCE · SUPPORT · RESTORE — three focused steps for the gut, the body and intimate flora.

settings.title: Every Detail Was Refined
settings.description: Strains, doses, capsules, packaging and claims were repeatedly reviewed with one standard in mind: every ingredient should have a role, and every product should earn its place in your day.

settings.title: This Is Only the Beginning
settings.description: Luma Pause begins with probiotics, but the ambition is broader: to be a trusted companion for women through every stage of midlife.

settings.eyebrow: Built with Intent. From Question to System
settings.heading: Shaped by listening and a commitment to real care.
